title: Steam shortcut created by Lutris breaks after upgrades with nix package manager
observation: Steam shortcut created by Lutris breaks after upgrades with nix package manager When adding a steam shortcut a few properties are set, including the path for the lutris binary. In the current implementation this path is always the full absolute path, which can be problematic when lutris is installed with the nix package manager. On nix, binaries in `$PATH` are symlinks pointing to immutable derivations in the Nix store. After a system or package upgrade, Lutris may be rebuilt, resulting in a different store path, while the Steam shortcut continues to reference the old one. - Installed lutris via nix and lutris is added to path.
